subject: Customer spotlight interview: recording consent & scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer spotlight interview: recording consent & scheduling

Hi Olivia —

Hope you're well. Following our brief conversation at the end of the Q2 business review, we'd love to capture Meridian Health's experience with Redwood for a short customer spotlight (written + 20–30 minute recorded interview). The goal is a 1-page highlight and a short video clip for our website and sales materials.

Quick asks so we can coordinate internally:
- Which Meridian stakeholders should join (product, security, clinical ops)?
- Any calendar constraints next week (we can be flexible)?
- Do you need a formal consent or NDA for the recording / quotes? We can use Redwood's standard recording consent but are happy to align with your legal/compliance process.

Proposed agenda (draft, attached): 15 min on outcomes + 10 min demo/technical points + 5 min next steps.

I've attached a draft agenda and our recording_consent_template.pdf for your review. If easier, feel free to pick a slot on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/meridian-spotlight-30m

If you confirm stakeholders, Monica (our customer success lead) will prep a short pre-interview brief to make the session efficient.

Thanks — excited to showcase what Meridian has built.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Meridian_case_study_agenda.docx (document), recording_consent_template.pdf (pdf)
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@meridianhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight interview: recording consent & scheduling

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — wed be happy to participate. Quick notes from our side:
- Attendees: me (Head of Digital Services), Rajiv Singh (Director of Clinical Data), and Maya Ortiz (PM, AI Integrations) — I looped Rajiv in.
- Compliance: Meridian needs a short consent form signed by the interviewee and a note that the clip will be used for marketing. Your recording_consent_template.pdf looks close; our legal team will send any edits but I expect minor changes only.
- Availability: Jul 20 (9–11am ET) and Jul 21 (1–4pm ET) work best for the group.

Could you please confirm whether Redwood will host the recording (Zoom) and whether you can provide an MP4 afterwards? Also please share the final agenda and any questions in advance.

Subject: Re: Customer spotlight interview: recording consent & scheduling

Thanks Olivia — great, appreciate the quick reply.

A few confirmations and next steps: 
- We'll host via Redwood's Zoom account, record to MP4, and share the raw file + edited clip within 5 business days.
- Proposed confirmed slots converted to PT: Jul 20 6:00–8:00am PT (9–11am ET) or Jul 21 10:00am–1:00pm PT (1–4pm ET). Please tell us which you prefer and whether Maya will join the meeting or provide notes.
- Consent: I'll attach the consent template as a DocuSign link for quick signature; if your legal sends edits please CC me so we can incorporate.
- Agenda & prep: Monica will send a 1-page prep brief (questions and outcomes) once you confirm the time.

Attached: Meridian_case_study_agenda.docx (updated), recording_consent_template.pdf. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/initiatives/EXAMPLE-12345 (placeholder)

If everything looks good I'll go ahead and schedule and send a calendar invite with the Zoom link.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
